clauses.reason: Executive Order 11549, signed 1970-07-28 (35 FR 12191), revokes Executive Order No. 10361 of June 11, 1952, which established the Whittier Defensive Sea Area, Alaska, under section 2152 of title 18, United States Code. The command is a one-time revocation, performed when the order takes effect. The order has no effective-date wording, so it took effect on signing, 1970-07-28 (the printing date 1970-07-30 is an alternative reading, not an end). The clause is exhausted by performance on that date (owner ruling 2026-10-28: a used one-time command is recorded as exhausted by performance, separate from any surviving consequence; the surviving consequence here is the revoked status of EO 10361, which is not a command of this order). The cited source is the order's own held text, which contains the words is hereby revoked. No earlier end is shown in held evidence.

savings.reason: The order contains no savings, exception, effective-date or notwithstanding wording; the held text was read in full. The revocation of EO 10361 was complete on 1970-07-28. Whatever the defensive sea area established by EO 10361 did before that date was an effect of the revoked order, not a command of this one; nothing in the held evidence shows a continuing right or duty arising from this order.
